assertions.name: phi0_normalization_not_constant_across_orders
assertions.unit: 1 = no constant N (|N_h2 − N_h4| ≥ 1e-6) ⇒ −64 is h²-only
assertions.source: N_h2 = alg_h2/κ = −64 ; N_h4 = alg_h4/κ₄ = +7.92 ; differ ⇒ no Φ₀

description: NEGATIVE: the Φ₀ '−64 normalization' relating the Q₈ crossed-module multiplicative-integral trace to the Borromean Markov trace is an h²-only coincidence. A constant N would give alg_h2/κ = alg_h4/κ₄; instead N_h2 = −64 but N_h4 = +7.92. No constant normalization exists. Disproves Link 4 of the algebraic→geometric→boundary chain. The proved facts (alg_h2 = −12, κ = 3/16) are unaffected but are NOT connected by a Φ₀ feedback map.
